# Toploader Trading Co.

> Pokémon card buyers and vendors based in Owensboro, Kentucky. We buy singles, graded slabs (PSA/BGS), sealed product, and full collections. We come to you anywhere in Western Kentucky or Southern Indiana.

## About

Toploader Trading Co. is a husband-and-wife Pokémon vendor team in Owensboro, KY. We are collectors who overdid it — the vast majority of what we sell came from our own personal collection. We vendor at card shows across Western Kentucky and Southern Indiana and offer in-home collection purchases throughout the region.

## Services

- [Bulk Card Estimator](https://toploadertrading.com/sell-pokemon-collections.html): Free instant price estimate for bulk Pokémon card collections. Enter your card counts (EX/GX/V/VMAX/ex, full arts, commons/uncommons) and get a same-day estimate.
- [Book an Appointment](https://toploadertrading.com/schedule-appointment.html): Schedule a free, no-obligation appraisal for singles, graded slabs, sealed product, or full collections. We come to you and offer cash or digital payment same day.

## What We Buy

- Raw singles (any set, any era)
- PSA and BGS graded slabs
- Sealed booster packs and Elite Trainer Boxes
- Full binder collections
- Vintage cards (Base Set era and earlier)
- Full art, alt art, rainbow rare, and Illustration Rare cards
